observations: 2026-10-27: the routes /api/v1/extract/text/file and /api/v1/parse/file are gone (404); the parsing routes are /api/v1/parse/engine-a/file and /api/v1/parse/engine-b/file, and every business route needs Authorization: Bearer sk-... (scope `parse`, or `extract` with extract_metadata=true).

/health takes no key and answers 200 whatever the key is. In the service's source (develop 7f79242) a request is authenticated before its parameters are read, and the scope is checked only after them: a route call with a key and no file is a 400 missing_file for a good key, 401 for a bad one, 404 for a moved route, and is never charged. The client's credential probe (DocumentParserClient.probe) relies on that ordering and on nothing else.
Engine A writes [Page N] lines into a PDF's content and a parse_info block; engine B returns neither, and its format and media_type are null. The page map is built from the markers.
A failed metadata analysis is still HTTP 200 with the whole content, metadata null and metadata_status failed.
